Layout: top navigation bar with JOBE left and Services / Case study / Contact links right; large hero section (about 45% of the page): left-aligned headline 'Engineering that Works' in bold display type, one line of gray placeholder copy beneath, a solid deep-blue primary button labeled 'Book a Product Readiness Call' and a text-link 'See the StockCast case'; below the hero a row of three equal service cards with title and placeholder lines; then a wide horizontal case-study band labeled 'StockCast' with an abstract chart shape and placeholder copy; then a thin strip with three small numbered steps (call, diagnosis, direction) as placeholders; dark footer. Everything aligned to a strict grid, generous spacing, hairline dividers.
